title: Bella and Skye Sort Dreams
markdown:
Once upon a meadow so sunny it sparkled lived Bella the bunny. Bella had the softest floppiest ears. Her little nose did a wiggle-wiggle when she was happy, and Bella was almost always happy. Her best friend was Skye, a kite dragon whose scales twinkled like a sky full of stars. Skye did not breathe hot fire. Skye blew warm breezy puffs that smelled like sunshine and cookies.

They lived in a cozy burrow at the meadow’s edge. Their favorite thing was to sort happy sparkly dreams that floated all around. They gathered them in a big soft basket woven from moonbeams. They made piles: giggle-dreams, flutter-dreams, and zoom-dreams. It was easy. It was fun.

One sunny morning a gigantic basket, bigger than Bella’s burrow, tumbled into the meadow. It was not made of moonbeams. It was made of the softest puffiest blankets, and inside, all the dreams were jumbled. Giggles tangled with wiggles. Zoom-dreams smooshed with flutter-dreams. Bella’s whiskers did a funny little wiggle. A mess.

Oh, Skye, Bella whispered, nose extra fast. A big mess of dreams. Bella liked things neat. Messes made her tummy feel like tiny butterflies. This mess made her feel very small.

Skye fluttered closer, kite-tail wings a gentle swish-swish. We’ll sort them. Together. Skye nudged the giant basket. The meadow won’t be happy until the dreams are happy again. The sunshine seemed to wink. If the dreams stayed jumbled, the meadow might hide its sparkles. They had to help.

So Bella the bunny and Skye the kite dragon hopped and fluttered into the giant blanket basket. The blankets were so soft, like being hugged by a cloud. The dreams inside were a jumble. Bella took a deep breath. One by one.

She found a dream that felt like tickly little feathers. A flutter-dream, tangled with a big sleepy yawn. She gently untangled the feather-tickles. Then a dream that felt like a warm fuzzy hug. A giggle-dream, stuck to a fluffy sleepy cloud. Hoo-hoo, Bella hummed, nose wiggling. Sometimes, when things got tangled, she wanted to hop right out. It felt as if the dreams were playing a game she had not learned.

We can do it, Bella, Skye said, blowing a soft cookie-scented breeze. Rainbow scales shone brighter.

Then they found a dream that felt like boing, boing, boing, and little puffs of giggles. A zoom-dream, Bella squeaked. Stuck to lots of other dreams. A super tangled mess. To get it free, Bella had to reach into a part of the blankets that was a little deeper and quiet. Not scary-dark. Quiet. Bella’s heart went thump-thump. She did not like quiet dark places. What if she touched something strange? Her paws felt a little cool. She waited.

Skye nudged her gently. Just a little reach. I’m right here. Skye’s voice was like a lullaby.

Bella took another breath. Whiskers trembling just a tiny bit. She thought about the sunny meadow and all the happy dreams. Then, slowly, she reached her paw into the quiet blanket-dark. Her paw felt the smooth edge of the zoom-dream, and nothing else. Just soft blankets. With a gentle pull she freed the boing-boing zoom-dream and a pile of happy giggles. The blankets felt like warm velvet against her fur. A tiny shiver went down her back, and then it went away.

Soon the basket was neat again. Giggle-dreams in one fluffy pile. Flutter-dreams in another. Zoom-dreams ready for adventure.

Bella and Skye hopped out, paws dusty with dream-fluff. The sunny meadow was sparkly again. Bella looked at the neat piles, nose wiggling with happiness. Sorting had been a tangled adventure. Reaching into the quiet had made her paws cool. Working with Skye, and seeing the dreams sorted, made her feel steady.

Later a tiny tickly feather from a flutter-dream floated past Bella’s nose. Once it might have made her whiskers twitch. Now Bella smiled. She reached out and caught the feather-dream. It felt light and happy. Even mixed-up things, she and Skye could sort. Together. That was the coziest feeling of all.
